change.item: Optimized Meta Pixel initialization to avoid loading the base code on frontend pages when PageView and ViewContent tracking are disabled.
Restricted Pixel initialization to relevant HikaShop checkout and order confirmation pages when global PageView and ViewContent tracking are disabled.
Improved fbp and fbc cookie capture to support pages where HikaShop JavaScript is unavailable.
Added a dedicated Meta CAPI helper to handle server-side PageView, ViewContent, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase events.
Refactored browser and order user-data collection for reuse across server-side events.
Added matching event IDs to support browser and server event deduplication.
Added InitiateCheckout event deduplication to prevent repeated server-side events during checkout.
Moved Purchase event payload construction and delivery into the dedicated Meta CAPI helper.
Clarified the confirmed-order handling configuration description, including invoice status validation and Purchase event deduplication.
Updated PixelEventsHelper to include matching event IDs in PageView, ViewContent, and InitiateCheckout browser events.
Integrated the Meta CAPI helper with the plugin's existing configuration parameters.
Updated Purchase event handling to use buildOrderUserData() for order-specific customer information.
Added configuration options for enabling or disabling individual server-side events.
Updated the Meta Graph API version to v27.0 and defined it as a class constant in MetaCapiHelper.

fixes.item: Fixed unnecessary Meta Pixel base code injection on all frontend pages when PageView and ViewContent tracking were disabled.
Fixed cookie capture dependency on HikaShop JavaScript readiness.
Improved server-side event deduplication using shared event IDs for browser and Conversions API tracking.
Prevented repeated InitiateCheckout server-side events for the same cart during checkout.
Fixed potential event ID mismatches between browser Pixel and Conversions API events.
Improved consistency of customer data used for server-side Purchase events.
Ensured checkout event IDs are available for browser Pixel tracking even when server-side InitiateCheckout tracking is disabled.

language.item: Updated English language strings for plugin configuration and event tracking settings.
Added English language strings and descriptions for the PageView, ViewContent, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase Conversions API settings.
Updated the plugin name and description to reflect its Meta Pixel and Conversions API integration with HikaShop.
Added French language strings for plugin configuration and event tracking settings.
Added French language strings and descriptions for the PageView, ViewContent, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase Conversions API settings.
Updated the French plugin name and description to reflect its Meta Pixel and Conversions API integration with HikaShop.

addition.item: Initial release of the Meta HikaShop plugin.
Integration of the Meta Pixel for browser-side event tracking.
Integration of Meta Conversions API for server-side Purchase event tracking.
Support for PageView, ViewContent, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase events.
Order status validation and duplicate Purchase event prevention.
Capture and storage of Meta browser identifiers (fbp and fbc) for server-side event matching.
Configurable event tracking, confirmed-order handling, and debug logging.
